about: The grown test applicant (owner's idea, 12 Oct 2026): the thin fake applicant of desktop/demo/draft.json after answering, once, the questions forms keep asking, as a real user does over their first applications. FAKE values only (example.test links, no real person). Picked by JP_APPLICANT=grown (lib/applicant-seed.mjs applicantDraft); the thin one stays the default so the pool stays comparable and recorded cases stable. Each batch is one changelog line naming what asked for it. Guard: e2e/test/applicant-grown.test.mjs.
replace: | Start date / notice period | 3 months' notice; can start 3 months after an offer |
answers_append:
# Questions forms keep asking

- How I heard of this job: the company's own careers website
- Current or former employee of the company I apply to: no, never (unless my CV lists it)
- Relatives, partner or close friends working at the company: none
- Salary expectation: CHF 150,000 a year, gross; when asked in euros: EUR 140,000 a year, gross
- Years of professional experience: 8
- Language levels: English C2 (fluent), Spanish native, German B1, French A1 (basic)
- Work authorisation outside Switzerland and the EU (e.g. the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada): not authorised, sponsorship needed
- Relocation: willing to relocate within Europe; not outside Europe
- Occasional business travel: yes
- Security clearance: none held; willing to apply where my citizenship allows
- Preferred language for the process: English
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.example.test/in/alex-example
- GitHub: https://github.example.test/alex-example
- Personal website: https://alex.example.test
